notes: SAIC is a diversified defense IT integrator (~$7.4B FY24 revenue, ~1,800 active contracts, ~24,000 employees). Filing is deliberately program-name-light: no PE numbers, no named Program-of-Record concentration, no quantified revenue attribution to specific Pentagon line items. J-Book divergence pattern requires named programs with material revenue attribution; SAIC's disclosure pattern is the opposite of small-cap PE-concentrated targets like IonQ/YSS. Extracted claims emphasize service-line and customer-class concentration with available J-Book-adjacent queries, plus control claims.

claims.claim_text: SAIC derived 98% of total revenues during each of fiscal 2024, 2023, and 2022 from contracts with the U.S. government as a prime contractor or subcontractor.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: We generated 98% of our total revenues during each of the last three fiscal years from contracts with the U.S. government either as a prime contractor or a subcontractor.

claims.claim_text: In fiscal 2024 the U.S. Army generated 17%, U.S. Navy 13%, Air Force 12%, Other DoD 10%, and Other federal government 46% of SAIC's total revenues.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.object_value: Army 17% / Navy 13% / Air Force 12% / Other DoD 10% / Other federal 46%
claims.source_quote: The U.S. Army, U.S. Navy and Air Force each generated more than 10% of our revenues during fiscal 2024.

claims.claim_text: SAIC serves approximately 1,800 active contracts and task orders across the U.S. government with approximately 24,000 employees.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: We serve our customers through approximately 1,800 active contracts and task orders. We have approximately 24,000 employees.

claims.claim_text: SAIC positions 'All Domain Warfighting' (JADC2-adjacent C4ISR / data connectivity for DoD + IC) as a core forward growth pillar, alongside Next Generation Space, Undersea Dominance, Border of the Future, and Citizen Experience.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: All Domain Warfighting: We develop integrated conflict deterrence, combat preparedness, and data connectivity capabilities for the US Military and Intelligence Community.

claims.claim_text: SAIC positions 'Next Generation Space' as a forward growth pillar — integrating advanced solutions to enable rapid deployment of future space missions (implicates SDA Transport/Tracking Layer and Space Force RDT&E lines).
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: Next Generation Space: We integrate advanced solutions to enable the rapid deployment of future space missions.

claims.claim_text: SAIC positions 'Undersea Dominance' (delivering systems to ensure US proactive control over every threat in the undersea domain) as a forward growth pillar — implicates Navy undersea / submarine combat systems lines.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: Undersea Dominance: We deliver systems to ensure the US maintains proactive control over every threat in the undersea domain.

claims.claim_text: SAIC provides 'Ground Vehicles Support' — integration, modification, upgrade, and sustainment of ground vehicles for the U.S. armed forces — a continuation of the business that historically included the (now terminated) Marine Corps Assault Amphibious Vehicle (AAV) prime contract.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: Ground Vehicles Support: We integrate, modify, upgrade, and sustain ground vehicles for our nation's armed forces.

claims.claim_text: SAIC positions enterprise IT modernization for defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies as the core forward portfolio (cloud, cybersecurity, software) — implicates large recompete-driven multi-year contract vehicles such as JWCC and intelligence-community enterprise IT.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: IT Modernization: We help defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies reimagine the way they accomplish their objectives through digital transformation by providing next-generation cloud computing, cybersecurity, and software capabilities.

claims.claim_text: SAIC is a contractor on Pentagon programs covered in the J-Book corpus; contractor-keyed lookup should return programs SAIC is primary on.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: We are one of the largest pure-play technology service providers to the U.S. government. ... we are a prime systems integrator on large, complex programs.

claims.claim_text: SAIC received Federal Grand Jury subpoenas (April 2022 and October 2023) from the DOJ Antitrust Division in connection with a criminal investigation; the company says it is fully cooperating and cannot estimate liabilities.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.object_value: DOJ Antitrust Division criminal investigation subpoenas (Apr 2022, Oct 2023)
claims.source_quote: In April 2022 and October 2023, the Company received Federal Grand Jury Subpoenas in connection with a criminal investigation being conducted by the U.S. Department of Justice, Antitrust Division ("DOJ").

claims.claim_text: SAIC operates from approximately 114 properties in 24 states, D.C. and various foreign countries; HQ in Reston, VA with principal locations in Chantilly/Arlington VA, Huntsville AL, Oak Ridge TN, El Segundo CA, Indianapolis/Bedford IN, and Charleston SC.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.source_quote: As of February 2, 2024, we conducted our operations at approximately 114 properties located in 24 states, the District of Columbia, and various foreign countries.

claims.claim_text: SAIC closed sale of its Supply Chain Business to ASRC Federal in May 2023 for $356M cash, divesting logistics/SCM to focus on differentiated tech services.
claims.subject: SAIC
claims.object_value: Supply Chain Business divested to ASRC Federal, $356M cash, May 2023
claims.source_quote: On May 6, 2023, SAIC closed the sale of its logistics and supply chain management business ('Supply Chain Business') to ASRC Federal Holding Company, LLC.
